THE PROJECTION

How much of v is along u?

↗

Keep the parallel part

A projection is the closest vector in a line or subspace. The leftover points perpendicular to it.

⊥

Subtract the overlap

Gram–Schmidt removes the projections onto directions already found. What remains is orthogonal to them.

1

Make it unit length

Divide each nonzero remainder by its length. The result is an orthonormal system: perpendicular, unit-length vectors.
